visa.note: 中国境内旅居（本国）；外籍人士以144/240小时过境免签及口岸政策官方口径为准

city.summary_zh: 游民CO 在列，茶城、四季如春、生活成本全国地板级，适合长住写作，医疗和交通是短板。
city.summary_en: Tea city, spring-like year round, floor-level cost; good for long writing stays.
sources: 游民CO youmin.co/locations — 发现线索
小住 StayHere stay.xbuding.com — 惠州等成本/房源实测线索
NomadsCN nomadscn.com — 中国城市游民指南线索

neighborhoods.name: 思茅老城·振兴大道 (Simao Old Town)
neighborhoods.vibe: 五一市场/市医院/老城商业，生活气最浓，长租一居供给最多
neighborhoods.note: 58同城 2026-11 在租一居 ¥1,100–1,250（利民小筑/普洱广场/中心商务区）≈$165；网易旅居实测称老城两居 ¥1,000–1,500

neighborhoods.name: 茶马古城·北部新区 (Chama Town / North)
neighborhoods.name_en: Chama Ancient Town / North New Area
neighborhoods.vibe: 茶马古城文旅区+北部湿地，新公寓多、带办公桌的游民公寓集中
neighborhoods.note: 估算：58同城茶马古城映山和园一居 ¥1,700、普洱中心两居 ¥1,700–2,000；网易实测称新城区游民公寓月租 ¥1,500–2,000，取一居约 ¥1,600≈$225

neighborhoods.name: 梅子湖片区 (Meizihu Lake)
neighborhoods.vibe: 梅子湖公园畔的养生公寓带，环境安静，离老城约 15 分钟
neighborhoods.best_for: 湖畔慢生活与康养长住
neighborhoods.note: 估算：迟归指南称梅子湖周边养生公寓包食宿短租 ¥3,500–8,000/月，长租一居按约 ¥1,500≈$210 估算

neighborhoods.name: 南屏·普洱学院 (Nanping / Pu'er University)
neighborhoods.vibe: 普洱学院与机场路一带，学生区物价低，房源偏小户型
neighborhoods.note: 估算：58同城机场小区一居 ¥800、北门街小户型 ¥500–550，长租一居按约 ¥900≈$125 估算

cost_usd_month.basis: cross_checked: 163.com on-the-ground stay rent CNY 1,200 + living CNY 1,500 = CNY 2,700/mo ≈ $380; kikiholidays winter long-stay (2026-11): couple covers accom+food+transport ~CNY 3,000/mo, 2BR central Simao CNY 1,000-1,800 — single-nomad total brackets $333-415, $380 kept as midpoint

internet_mbps.basis: cross_checked: Rewire Simao avg 70 Mbps; cnblogs 2026-11-22 field report: 300M/500M/1000M plans on sale in Simao, a 500M plan measured 80M at night — real-world working speed ~70; v1 seed 90 Mbps had no stated basis, revised down to 70
